Video Editing

Nightshift

Four hours of handheld night footage, cut until it felt like a single unbroken breath.

Client
Lowbeam
Year
2025
Role
Edit & Colour
Category
Motion & Video — Video Editing
Motion & Video2025Edit & Colour
Overview

Lowbeam

The band wanted the feeling of one continuous take without the limits that come with actually shooting one. The edit hides its seams: every cut lands on a light source crossing frame, so the eye never catches the join.

Colour was pulled toward sodium and shadow — amber streetlight against a cold blue base — with grain held rather than cleaned, because the footage’s imperfections were the point.

The best cut is the one the audience feels in their chest before they see it.
Creative process

Four moves, every project

  1. 01

    Paper edit

    Four hours logged by light, movement and lyric — not by the storyboard.

  2. 02

    Assembly

    Structure built to the song’s stems, with transitions hidden inside light wipes.

  3. 03

    Grade

    Sodium amber against cold blue base, grain retained, blacks lifted slightly.

  4. 04

    Sound pass

    Location ambience layered under the mix so the city never leaves the frame.
